aggregation.matrix: mean accuracy over all outer-fold/initialization-seed entries
aggregation.pooled_fold_seed_accuracy_sd: population SD over all fold/seed accuracies; not a confidence interval
aggregation.seed_level_accuracy_mean: mean of the five seed-level means, where each seed-level mean averages folds
aggregation.seed_level_accuracy_sd: population SD across the five seed-level means; not a confidence interval
aggregation.fold_level_accuracy_mean: mean of the five fold-level means, where each fold-level mean averages seeds
aggregation.fold_level_accuracy_sd: population SD across the five fold-level means; not a confidence interval

architecture.preprocessing: inner scaler on source inner-training rows; fresh final scaler on all source outer-training rows

training.final_refit: fresh scaler and model fit on full outer-training source rows for selected epoch count

metric_semantics.source_validation: epoch-selection model, held-out source validation rows
metric_semantics.source_training: final fresh-refit model, all source outer-training rows

training.determinism: Python/NumPy/torch CPU/CUDA seeds set; CUDA may retain kernel caveats
